# reverse-skill

When analyzing an APK, binary, frontend JS encryption, a CTF challenge, or a pentesting target, follow the routing matrix in this directory.

To use, refer to `RULES.md` and `skills/MASTER-ROUTING.md` in this directory, or run `scripts/master-route.ps1` (or equivalent shell script) for triage.
